subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding square roots and cube roots, including estimating non-perfect roots
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds physical square/cube arrangements to find perfect square and cube roots
exercise.pictorial: Student places a non-perfect square root on a number line between the two nearest perfect squares
exercise.abstract: Student calculates or estimates square and cube roots of given numbers

misconception_flags: confuses squaring with square rooting, or cubing with cube rooting

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
